content.rendered:
STOMP, CHOMP AND READ!! Visit our DINO-MITE book fair and stock up for your summer reading fun.  

Book Fair hours are as follows:
Monday, April 29th 7:30-3:30
Tuesday, April 30th 7:30-3:30
Wednesday, May 1st 7:30-3:30
Thursday, May 2nd 7:30 – 8:00 pm – OPEN ALL DAY – During Conferences
Friday, May 3rd CLOSED
